sections.heading: Double Integrals, Polar Coordinates & Jacobians Practice Exercises

questions.q: Compute \( \iint_R dA \) for \( R=[0,4]\times[0,3] \) (the area of \( R \)).
questions.answer: Applying Double Integrals principles, \( \text{Area}=4\times3=12 \). Therefore, the verified correct option is 12.
